title: Prefs
description: Contents of ol-prefs. Device-local UI state. An empty object is valid; the app fills in missing fields on load.

program.description: Selected catalog program id. Unknown ids fall back to the first program (gym).

session.description: Selected session id. Unknown ids fall back to the program's first session.

progressEx.description: Progress chart selection, keyed by series: 'n|' + lowercased, whitespace-collapsed exercise name.

progressId.description: Legacy progress selection by exercise id. Read only as a fallback when progressEx does not match.
